title: Context Transfer
goal: Reuse an existing artifact/result in a new context only after checking applicability, provenance, and contextual differences.
context: Standardized execution contract. Runtime inputs supplied through Human Residence are authoritative; fixture materials are validation aids, not hidden answers.
constraints: Character reports are separate inspectable artifacts.
Combined reports reference child artifacts rather than replacing them.
Visualization must be derived from structured report data.
Human intervention must preserve prior revisions.
